rooms.name: Plane of Air
rooms.desc:
This chamber is formed from four pillars standing upright on the otherwise
bleak, featureless plain.  Spread between the pillars on the south side of the
chamber is a portal of some kind that glows a bright red color and heats the
air in this chamber.

rooms.name: Plane of Air
rooms.desc:
The room here is composed of four pillars on each of the four corners and a
large portal thrusting up from the ground to the north.  The portal is made of
some crystaline material that you have never seen before.  In the center of 
the portal is a large keyhole.  The strange thing about this portal is, you
can look right through it!  It appears to go no where!  To the west is a portal
of some sort which is a strange bluish-green color.

extras.desc:
Thought for today:
                     Life is Shit.

An oak tree taller than any other tree here towers above you.  On one
of the lower branches lounges a red and white striped cat.  Noticing the
sudden attention you're giving it, the Cheshire Cat grins at you and
slowly fades out of existence piece by piece until all that's left is
a set of grinning white teeth.  After a few moments, these too disappear
and the faint sound of laughter echoes in your ears.

Gazing down into its watery depths, you see glimpses of brightly colored
fish swimming and darting about playfully.  The water is so clear you can
see straight to the bottom which is made of a fine white sand.  When you
finally tear your eyes away from the enchanting beauty of this pool, you
notice that several hours have gone by.

rooms.name: Stic's Chamber of War
rooms.desc:
You find yourself deep in an underground bunker illuminated by a single
red lightbulb dangling from the celing.  Occasionally there will be a
loud THUMP! and plaster chunks fall from the celing and break on the floor
into little white clouds of dust.  Somewhere towards the back of the room
you see a shadow of movement.  Peering closer into the shadows you can
make out a large desk with a figure behind it.  Suddenly the desk lights
up with a pale yellow glow, illuminating the figure behind it.  Stic
cackles insanely as he moves a little figure across a large sheet of
parchment.  As you watch the figure explodes into a miniature ball of 
fire, leaving nothing behind but a smoking corpse.  Stic looks up at you
and grins evilly.

1005.name: a cow
1005.long: A cow is here, chewing her cud.
1005.desc:
The cow looks like it hasn't been milked in quite some time.  Although she
is past her prime, you see that she still has a lot of years left, and that
if provoked, her rear kick can be quite deadly.

sounds.far: You hear the lowing of a cow

1007.name: a chicken
1007.long: A chicken sits on her nest.
1007.desc: The chicken is bright and healthy.  She has no weapons but her beak.

1009.name: a horse
1009.long: A horse becomes frightened by your presence.
1009.desc: The horse looks at you and turns away.  You can tell that it is afraid of you.

2300.name: A large farm dog
2300.long: A farm dog stands here, barking at your approach.
2300.desc: This dog is really scruffy looking.  One good way to describe him is mutt.

2301.name: Farmer
2301.long: A farmer stands here, working his field.
2301.desc: This man is rather weather beaten, and poor.

2302.name: The farmer's son
2302.long: The farmer's son stands here helping his father.
2302.desc:
This young man is a smaller version of his father.  He is malnurished, but
happy with life.  He smiles at you when he notices your interest in him.

2303.name: Elmo
2303.long: Elmo sits here getting very drunk.
2303.desc:
This man looks like he can take care of himself with ease.  He glares at
you as you enter the room.

sounds.near: Elmo says, 'There is a moathouse north of the road east of town.'
sounds.far: Loud singing can be heard from the room to the south.

2305.name: John the leather worker
2305.long: John the leather worker stands here running his shop.
2305.desc:
This mans skin is much like his wares, very leathery.  He has every kind of
leather item that you could think of for sale.

2306.name: Rannos Davl
2306.long: Rannos Davl stands here running the local Trading Post.
2306.desc:
This man is rather shady looking.  Makes you wonder what one so evil looking
is doing in a town that is so good.

2307.name: Greemag grins evilly and
2307.long: Greemag looks at you and sneers evilly.
2307.desc:
Greemag lets out a low growl when he notices you looking at him.  He pulls
out his dagger and stabs it into the table, then looks at you with a very evil
look.

2308.name: A guard
2308.long: A guard stands here, guarding all around him.
2308.desc:
This man looks bored with life.  He stands here, half-asleep.  He does look
like he would not hesitate to kill you if you do cross him.

2310.name: The man-at-arms
2310.desc:
This man takes his job seriously.  He watches you solemnly as you enter 
the shop, his eyes following you everywhere.

2311.name: The large war dog
2311.long: A large dog snarls at your approach.
2311.desc:
This dog looks vicious.  I He    She looks like she wouldn't hesitate to rip your
throu at out if you cor  rossed her.  She does not look very friendly.

2312.name: Melubb the moneychanger
2312.long: Melubb the money changer stands here, ready to convert your gems into cash.
2312.desc:
For what his job is, Melubb doesn't seem to be doing so well.  He looks 
like he doesn't have 1000 coins to his name, much less any gems!

2313.name: Jaroo Ashstaff
2313.long: Jaroo Ashstaff stands here, one with nature.
2313.desc:
It is said that this man is in possession of some knowledge that you might
need.  Then again, it could have been a rumor.  
  Jaroo is a druid.  He looks well placed in this wooded area.  The large 
black bear at his side throws off any further doubts to his profession.

sounds.near: Jaroo sy ays, 'At the bottom of the moathouse is a man with key to temple.'
sounds.far: You can see a man in a clearing to the north, becoming one with nature.

2315.name: Burne the magic-user
2315.long: Burne the magic-user stands here studying his spell book.
2315.desc:
This is one of the two heroes of the town.  Him and Rufus defeated a band
of evil thugs working out of the surrounding woods.  Since then, they have
decided to move into town and stay.

2316.name: Rufus the warrior
2316.long: Rufus the warrior stands here looking over the plans to the new castle.
2316.desc:
This man looks none to bright, full of more brawn than brains.  He smiles
at you when you enter and asks you if he could show you around.

2317.name: A foreman
2317.long: A foreman overwatches the workers as they work to build the castle.
2317.desc:
This man looks like he is too arrogant for the good of his workers.  He is
constantly degrading and berating the workers on being to slow.  If he would
only work as hard as he yells, they might have the castle done within the year.

2318.name: A worker
2318.long: A worker is moving stones about.
2318.desc:
This man looks malnourished and over worked.  He hates his boss with a 
passion.  The evil looks he give  s him and muttering makes you almost fear for
the foreman's life.

2319.name: Zert the fighter
2319.desc:
This man is very drunk, and very aggressive.  He looks like he could 
attack you any minute now.  He says something about everyone being out to
kill him.  You are not very sure what his problem is...besides being toasted.

2320.name: A serving wench
2320.long: A very feminine serving wench is here, ready to take your order.
2320.desc:
This beautiful woman meets your eyes and smiles.  She asks you if you need
anything, meanwhile backhanding a patron that gets too fresh with her.

2322.name: The brigand
2322.long: A brigand stands here eyeing you.  He attacks as soon as you notice him.
2322.desc:
This man is ruthless to the end.  He would kill his own mother if he thought
she had enough money to make it worthl while...then again, he might do it just
for fun also.

2324.name: Green slime
2324.long: Some green slime falls onto you from above.  It's starting to burn into you.
2324.desc: Better get this stuff off of you soon.  If you don't, you are one dead pc.

2325.name: The zombie
2325.long: A zombie lets out an awful noise and moves towards you.
2325.desc:
This long dead person is covered with various lesions, wounds, and various
types of mold and other decomposers.  He is giving off an odor that makes you 
gag forceably.  Who ever made them evidently left orders to attack anyone that
enters the room, because they attack you upon sight of you.

2326.name: Large ogre
2326.long: An ogre sits here, watching what is transpiring around him.
2326.desc:
This fearsome creature is large and brutish looking.  He is not likely to
appreciate your interest in him.

2327.name: A bugbear
2327.desc:
This bugbear is supposed to be guarding.  He isn't doing a very good job
at it though.

2328.name: A gnoll
2328.long: A gnoll stands here looking very stupid.
2328.desc:
This creature has a very low brain capacity.  They seem to just want to play
knucklebones and sleep.

2329.name: The giant crayfish
2329.long: The giant crayfish burst forth from the pool.
2329.desc:
This fearsome looking creature looks like it has seen better days.  Big 
gashes in it's sides show that more than once it has been attacked.  You can
hardly be sympathetic though, since it is attacking you now.

2330.name: Laret
2330.long: Laret eyes you and then attacks.
2330.desc:
He is the head of the moathouse.  You can see a large key tucked into his
belt, the key that you have been looking for.

2331.name: Dick Rentsch
2331.long: Dick Rentsch stands here running his hostel.
2331.desc:
Dick is a burly fellow with a scarred, pockmarked visage, one eye covered
by a patch.  When you enter the hostel, he eyes your weapons warily.

2332.name: Wag the barman
2332.long: Wag stands here tending the bar, and occasionally shoving a patron th o the door.
2332.desc:
This man is rather tall and lanky.  He has a greasy look to his appearance.
The stuff he serves looks watered down, but drinkable.

2333.name: Dala the wench
2333.long: Dala the serving wench weaves in and about the tables, dodging patrons.
2333.desc:
This slutty looking female winks at you when she sees you looking at you. ,
at the same time wacking a patron over the head with her tray for his not
paying before touching.

2334.name: A patron
2334.long: A patron sits here wathing the minstrel play.
2334.desc:
This man is most likely a farmer from the looks of him.  He is here enjoying
the music and the company of friends.

2335.name: The patron
2335.long: The patron is here looking over you and your valuables.
2335.desc:
This seedy looking fellow looks like he might just kill you for the fun of
it.  He does not look like the kind of man you would trust with your life.

2336.name: Chon, the smith's son
2336.long: Chon, the smith's son, stands here grinning from ear to ear.
2336.desc:
This young boy looks none to bright.  All he does is stand there grinning
at you and listening to his father.  Makes you wonder if he might have been
kicked in the head by a horse when he was a youth.

2337.name: Otis the smithy
2337.long: Otis, the owner of this smithy and stable, smiles at your approach.
2337.desc:
This man is kind.  He is also well built, muscles bulging from his arms and
legs.  He looks like he could give you a sound thrashing if you crossed him.

2338.name: Mother Screng
2338.long: Mother Screng stands here selling her herbs.
2338.desc:
This old gnarled women is in one word, old.  She is stopped and seems to
walk with a shuffling gait that tells you she is probably arthritic.

2339.name: Hruda
2339.long: Hruda, mother Screng's daughter, is here assisting her.
2339.desc:
This woman isn't much prettier than Mother Screng(which says a lot).  She
is very homely, and very ragged.  She smiles, a nearly toothless grin, at you
when you enter the shop.

2340.name: Skole the proprieter
2340.long: Skole stands here serving drinks to some rough looking individuals.
2340.desc:
This man is rough looking, with scars covering his face and body.  He glares
at you when he notices that you have not bought something yet.

2343.name: A gnoll skeleton
2343.long: A skeleton of a gnoll lies here.
2343.desc: This skeleton is of a long deceased gnoll.  Nothing of value is on the corpse.

2348.name: The Earth Elemental
2348.long: A moun  d of earth is forming up in front of you.
2348.desc:
This creature looks like a large mound of earth that has suddenly reared up
for the attack.

3404.name: A wight
3404.desc:
The wight is long dead and looks at you with hateful eyes. He moves toward
you slowly with his weapon drawn.

17014.name: The ghoul
17014.desc: Looks like it's back from the grave!

2315.name: a pair of breeches
2315.long: A pair of worn breeches lie in the dust at your feet.

2316.name: a hand woven tunic
2316.long: A flea ridden tunic lies in the dust here.

2317.name: a pair of worn shoes
2317.long: A pair of worn leather shoes, complete with laces of twine, lie here.

extras.desc: A strange runed covered horsehoe is attached to a chain.
